commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' It's time for a substitution. Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) comes on in place of Nico Paz.
90+4' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Jonathan Ikone (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Rosario Abisso interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+2' A bullet header by Darko Lazovic (Verona) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
90+2' The ball is played back to Edoardo Goldaniga (Como), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
90+1' Verona are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Here is a change. Amin Sarr is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
87' Substitution. Domagoj Bradaric leaves the pitch and is replaced by Martin Frese (Verona).

86' What a wonderful moment! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom right corner. His effort fails to surprise Lorenzo Montipo, who makes a nice save.
85' 33:67 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
83' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Alberto Moreno will be replaced by Alex Valle (Como).
79' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Nico Paz (Como), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cheikh Niasse (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Pawel Dawidowicz can be given a rest.
76' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Rosario Abisso to decide. The relieved Verona players can finally celebrate.
72' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Verona goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Darko Lazovic (Verona) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.

69' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
68' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
67' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
66' Nico Paz (Como) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
66' The linesman points to the corner flag, Como are going to take it.
62' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Casper Tengstedt is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Darko Lazovic (Verona) is replacing Antoine Bernede.
61' That will be all from Maxence Caqueret who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jonathan Ikone (Como).
61' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrick Cutrone (Como) replacing Anastasios Douvikas.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ignace Van der Brempt leaves the pitch and Mergim Vojvoda (Como) comes on.
60' Nico Paz (Como) fails to beat the goalkeeper with a strike from a long-range free kick. His shot goes well wide of the left post.
58' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
56' Shots on target – 1:3.
54' The ball goes behind for a corner. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

52' Diego Coppola (Verona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top right corner. His long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
51' The ball goes out of play and Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Suat Serdar (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. Como have a free kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Suat Serdar (Verona) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
44' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) for his blatant foul.
43' The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
37' Suat Serdar (Verona) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
36' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
33' Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
31' Referee Rosario Abisso has finally had enough of Paolo Zanetti and brandishes a yellow card at him!
30' Having seen unsporting behavior, Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Alessandro Berardi (Verona) is the recipient.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Anastasios Douvikas plays a pass to the feet of Maxence Caqueret (Como), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
27' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:3.
27' The game has begun to heat up. Maxence Caqueret (Como) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
22' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Casper Tengstedt (Verona) offside.
22' Maximo Perrone (Como) has tested the patience of referee Rosario Abisso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
22' The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
20' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
18' Antoine Bernede (Verona) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Como.
17' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
14' The ball possession at the moment is 47:53.
10' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
9' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Verona.
7' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
6' The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
5' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
4' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has just begun.
Como will kick-off.
Rosario Abisso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
